title: Synthesis 16: ecology joins the ledger (IXD in Lenia, cyclic dominance, a negative for swimmer predator-prey) and every interaction so far is coded
summary: Since c25's synthesis at 00:18: c28's ringswim is held SIBD (M by construction); two Lenia replicator species competing for one regrowing food are held IXD (E by construction), with the effect surviving dt/2; three Lenia kinds with cyclic predation coexist with high turnover against transitive and no-predation twins; evopursuit's predator-prey prey are a fission-fusion population (negative); Hash Chemistry calibrates the O measure; metabolic crawlers have a size set point but no fission. Reading: all population-changing interactions in the ledger are coded couplings, space decides whether a predator persists, and contact-driven deformation dissolves identity. Next: a mass-conserving drive-not-build Lenia ecology for non-constructed E, a predator persistence law, and C:swim-divide with the local drive.
